debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term technical confluence (supertrend, Ichimoku, volume) with contrarian fear-zone opportunity and price near support (36.91) offers tactical swing entry for mean-reversion traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar), price below 200-MA/50-SMA, MACD/Hull/PSAR non-confirmation, Bollinger squeeze limiting breakout, and earnings binary risk in 48 days outweigh short-term bullish signals.
